svg.title: NCP low-overhead runtime path
svg.desc: Informative proposed B01 runtime path for the UNRELEASED 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate. It separates prepare-once work from a bounded frame path, a short owner transition, and an unlocked handoff. Its latency and memory equations are symbolic design bounds, not measurements. It is not implementation, release, performance qualification, or certification evidence.
